proof_body:
by
  intro t x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ h0 h1
  constructor
  · have h : ((1 - t) * x₁ + t * x₂ - x₁) ^ 2 + ((1 - t) * y₁ + t * y₂ - y₁) ^ 2 = t ^ 2 * ((x₂ - x₁) ^ 2 + (y₂ - y₁) ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [h, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg t), Real.sqrt_sq h0]
  · have h : (x₂ - ((1 - t) * x₁ + t * x₂)) ^ 2 + (y₂ - ((1 - t) * y₁ + t * y₂)) ^ 2 = (1 - t) ^ 2 * ((x₂ - x₁) ^ 2 + (y₂ - y₁) ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [h, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg (1 - t)), Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)]
target_source: ∀ (t x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → Real.sqrt (((1 - t) * x₁ + t * x₂ - x₁) ^ 2 + ((1 - t) * y₁ + t * y₂ - y₁) ^ 2) = t * Real.sqrt ((x₂ - x₁) ^ 2 + (y₂ - y₁) ^ 2) ∧ Real.sqrt ((x₂ - ((1 - t) * x₁ + t * x₂)) ^ 2 + (y₂ - ((1 - t) * y₁ + t * y₂)) ^ 2) = (1 - t) * Real.sqrt ((x₂ - x₁) ^ 2 + (y₂ - y₁) ^ 2)
